name: Fate/EXTELLA
source:
The Moon Cell Automaton is a spiritron computer, which exists on the moon and has the power to grant any wish. All across the spiritron-constructed virtual world, SE.RA.PH, Servants and the Masters who control them fight for the right to be the Moon Cell Automaton’s one owner in a ceremonial conflict known as the Holy Grail War.

Now, the Servant Nero Claudius and her Master have won the Holy Grail War and have obtained the universal wishing mechanism, the Holy Grail.

They also obtained the Regalia, a ring that proves their kingship. With it, they rule over their once-enemy Servants and start a new beginning on the moon’s new world.

But a new enemy has appeared before them. And this enemy has something that shouldn’t exist: another Regalia.

[From [url=http://www.xseedgames.com/games/fateextella-the-umbral-star/]official English site[/url]]

Fate/Extella: The Umbral Star is the newest installment to the Fate series of games/anime. Developed by Marvelous and co-published by Marvelous and XSeed. This is an action hack and slash game with RPG elements.
translation:
月细胞自动机是一台存在于月球上的灵子计算机，拥有实现任何愿望的能力。在灵子构建的虚拟世界SE.RA.PH中，Servant和控制他们的Master们在一场被称为圣杯战争的仪式性冲突中争夺成为Moon Cell Automaton的唯一所有者的权利。

现在，Servant尼禄·克劳狄乌斯和她的Master赢得了圣杯战争，并获得了通用的许愿装置——圣杯。

他们还获得了Regalia，这是一枚证明他们王权的戒指。有了它，他们统治了曾经的敌人仆人，并在月球的新世界开始了新的开始。

但新的敌人出现在他们面前。而这个敌人有一些不应该存在的东西：另一件王权。

[来自[url=http://www.xseedgames.com/games/fateextella-the-umbral-star/]英文官方网站[/url]]

Fate/Extella：暗影之星是Fate系列游戏/动漫的最新作品。由Marvelous开发，由Marvelous和XSeed联合出版。这是一款带有RPG元素的动作砍杀游戏。
